takes.title: Salsa crossing steps and turns, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns with bent knees, crosses the feet, and alternates gestures near the face and outward.

takes.title: Salsa steps with raised arms, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B uses crossing steps and pivots, gesturing forward and lifting the arms near and above the head.

takes.title: Salsa steps with hand gestures, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B moves through small steps, turns and occasional knee lifts, with one hand gesturing near the face or outward.

takes.title: Salsa steps with overhead gesture, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and pivots with bent knees, briefly raises an arm over the head, then continues stepping and gesturing.

takes.title: Salsa steps with overhead arms, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns, reaches one arm out, raises both hands overhead, and continues small crossing steps.

takes.title: Salsa crossing steps and open arms, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B crosses and uncrosses the feet while turning, with alternating hand gestures and a brief open-armed pose.

takes.title: Salsa steps with upward reaches, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and pivots with one hand near the face, then raises an arm overhead and continues dancing.

takes.title: Salsa steps and forward bend, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns with hands gesturing near the face and overhead, then folds forward at the end.

takes.title: Salsa steps with raised arm and bow, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns with repeated overhead arm gestures, then slows and bends forward at the end.

takes.title: Salsa steps with overhead reach, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B makes small bent-knee steps and turns, then lifts the hands near and above the head while stepping.

takes.title: Salsa steps and low dip, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns with arm gestures, drops into a low bent-knee dip with one arm raised, then rises.

takes.title: Salsa crossing steps and overhead reach, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B cross-steps and pivots with arms gesturing outward, raising a hand overhead before coming to a stand.

takes.title: Salsa steps with hand to head, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and pivots while gesturing with both hands, lifts a hand to the head, then finishes upright.

takes.title: Salsa steps with backward lean, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and turns, briefly leans far backward with arms raised, then resumes small steps and hand gestures.

takes.title: Salsa steps and arm gestures, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B steps and pivots with arms moving across the body and outward, lifts a hand overhead, and finishes standing.
